notes: Samsung prints Dimension & Weight as WIDTH x HEIGHT x DEPTH; mapped to height/width/depth accordingly. Samsung never publishes a crease shape (teardrop/U) for any Flip, so hinge.crease is null throughout. hinge.max_angle_deg left null: Samsung states Flex Mode working angles, not a maximum hinge angle. Folded thickness published as a range: 17.1mm at the hinge, 15.9mm at the tapered end; 15.9 in closed.depth, 17.1 in depth_at_hinge (identical folded thickness figures to Flip3 but independently sourced from the Flip4 release, not carried over). Cover Screen refresh rate NOT stated - null. Cover glass is Victus PLUS on this generation (Victus on Flip3, Victus 2 from Flip5) - the '+' is rendered as a separate element in Samsung's HTML, hence the split quote. || EVIDENCE SWEEP 2026-09-13: these values were present in the research pass but carried NO sources[] entry covering their field, so they were set to null per the registry rule (a value without a citation is an assertion, not evidence).
